changes_this_cycle: Expanded non-Mundarica web discovery from 52 to 56 verified source leads without changing the audited MMSC identity total of 27.

Added WEB-MUN-0053 Census of India C-16 Population by mother tongue, India 2011 as an official demographic/language dataset lead; census language returns are explicitly not treated as complete cultural identity or community-membership measures.

Added WEB-MUN-0054 Language Atlas of India 1991 using national-library bibliographic verification and the ORGI Language Division description; map/table evidence remains period-specific and requires exact atlas locators.
Added WEB-MUN-0055 Ahmed Shamim's 2021 CUNY doctoral dissertation on Koda as a comparative Munda-language lead; findings are explicitly barred from transfer to Mundari without independent evidence.

Added WEB-MUN-0056 Mundari.in as a contemporary web/media discovery lead; individual songs, videos, images, worship materials and statements require item-level provenance, rights, consent and cultural-access review.
Synchronized the MMSC index and reproducible search log to 56 sequential discovery leads while preserving zero discovery leads in the audited identity total.
Extended source-discovery integrity tests through WEB-MUN-0056, including demographic-category, historical-atlas, comparative-language and web-media scope/rights boundaries.

Extended publication metric generation to expose web_discovery_leads_observed and web_discovery_leads_counted_in_audited_identity_total separately from audited sources, then regenerated JSON and LaTeX metrics to 56 and 0 respectively.

Streamlit needs no filename-specific patch because its current discovery loader dynamically loads web_discovery expansion JSON files; the new leads therefore enter the searchable discovery layer without changing cultural evidence tables.
No cultural, linguistic, demographic, religious or media proposition was promoted from discovery metadata into evidence, and no public availability was interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.

blockers: Volume I lacks a registered authoritative scan artifact for scan-to-transcription reconciliation.

Census language categories require exact table/variable/geography extraction and must not be equated automatically with cultural identity, ethnicity, community membership or contemporary language vitality.
Language Atlas map/table evidence requires exact page/map locators and historical 1991 Census framing before evidence use.
Comparative Koda/Kɔɖa findings must not be transferred to Mundari without independent Mundari evidence.

Competing lexical-class analyses must be represented as attributed interpretations/contradictions rather than collapsed into a single settled claim.
Participant-derived speech recordings or datasets require source-specific consent/data-governance review and MLHKP cultural-access controls before ingestion.
Ethnobotanical/medicinal knowledge requires exact-locator evidence, safety review, consent/provenance checks, benefit-sharing consideration and cultural-access controls before structured public use.
